prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Analysis reveals CWT_rf as trend champion (avg_trend_corr=1.0) and rf as seasonality champion (avg_seasonal_corr=0.6449), while DWT_rf dominates overall RMSE (42.91). The extreme RMSE spread ratio (22.89) and high seasonality variance (0.93) indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit decomposition-aware combination. Early horizon specialist DWT_catboost (16.51 RMSE) differs from late specialist DWT_rf (52.95 RMSE), suggesting per-horizon optimization value.
